_note: B-39. Sign-in failure codes (AADSTS, as status.errorCode in the Entra sign-in log) mapped to a plain cause and the lever a technician may ask a lead to approve. Source for every row: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/reference-error-codes (read 2026-10-21). 'verified' means the code and its meaning were found on that page; 'UNVERIFIED' means they were not. The plain cause and the next step are this repo's wording, not Microsoft's. 'lever' is a name for a technician to consider; nothing here runs it.

codes.name: InvalidUserNameOrPassword
codes.cause: The password (or user name) typed was wrong.
codes.next: Usually a typo. Check the places and counts in the technician view: failures from places the person was not point to password guessing, not a typo.

codes.name: IdsLocked
codes.cause: The account is locked after too many wrong passwords, or the sign-in came from an IP address with malicious activity.
codes.next: Find out whether the person caused it. If the failures came from several places, treat it as password guessing and tell the security lead before unlocking anything.

codes.name: UserDisabled
codes.next: Check the offboarding or leave ticket. Re-enabling is a lead's decision, not a fix to try.

codes.name: InvalidPasswordExpiredPassword
codes.next: The person is normally offered a reset at sign-in; otherwise a password reset is done by a technician after the person is verified by callback on file.

codes.name: UserStrongAuthClientAuthNRequiredInterrupt
codes.cause: Multifactor authentication was required and the person did not pass the challenge.
codes.next: Ask whether they have their phone and the authenticator app. If the phone is lost or replaced, an MFA reset (after callback verification) is the fix.

codes.name: UserStrongAuthClientAuthNRequired
codes.cause: A policy or a new location requires multifactor authentication for this sign-in.
codes.next: Normally expected and the person completes it. If they cannot, check their MFA methods.

codes.name: UserStrongAuthEnrollmentRequired
codes.cause: Multifactor authentication is required and the person has not registered a method.
codes.next: Walk the person through registering a method. If they are stuck on an old registration, an MFA reset (after callback verification) clears it.

codes.name: UserStrongAuthEnrollmentRequiredInterrupt
codes.cause: The person must enrol a second factor and is mid-registration.
codes.next: Let them finish registering. If it keeps repeating, an MFA reset (after callback verification) clears it.

codes.name: BlockedByConditionalAccess
codes.cause: A Conditional Access policy blocked the sign-in.
codes.next: Read which policy applied (place, device, app). Changing Conditional Access stays with a human; do not weaken it for one call.

codes.name: DeviceNotCompliant
codes.cause: A policy requires a compliant device and this device is not compliant.
codes.next: The device needs to be enrolled or fixed in device management; the account is fine.

codes.name: BlockedByConditionalAccessOnSecurityPolicy
codes.cause: A tenant security policy blocks the request.
codes.next: Read the tenant security policies; changing them stays with a human.

codes.name: UserAccountNotFound
codes.cause: The user name does not exist in the directory the sign-in went to.
codes.next: Check the spelling and the tenant; do not create an account to make it work.

codes.name: External security challenge not satisfied
codes.cause: The person had to complete an extra step (terms of use or a third-party MFA) and did not.
codes.next: This alone is not a failure on the person's part; ask what screen they saw.

codes.name: UserInformationNotProvided
codes.cause: A silent sign-in found no signed-in session.
codes.next: Expected when the person is not signed in yet; usually not a problem by itself.

codes.name: UNVERIFIED (not found on the reference page)
codes.cause: Probably a failed multifactor authentication step. UNVERIFIED: this code was not found on the reference page, so treat the cause as a guess.
codes.next: Ask what happened at the MFA prompt before choosing a fix.
